remarks: A stately approach evokes the grandeur of this elegant five bedroom Colonial. Perfectly sited on two park-like acres in a premier west side cul de sac location, the refined luxury, classic details and serene decor will delight anyone looking for something truly special. This home embodies gracious sophistication with comfortable living. Light filled formal and informal rooms feature high ceilings, six fireplaces, custom crafted millwork, exquisite chef's kitchen, en-suite bedrooms and primary suite with marble bath to rival any five-star hotel. Outdoor living is equally elegant with mature landscaping, stone walls, gorgeous flower gardens, bluestone terrace, built-in grill and firepit as well as an 8 foot inground spa . For additional enjoyment, the airy lower level offers a gym and custom media/recreation area with fireplace. With over 7900 Sq Ft of finished living area, this beautiful home has the perfect blend of space for every lifestyle. Just minutes from town and privately nestled in a great neighborhood perfect for strolling, biking and making new friends.
